entities.name: Goose Mother
entities.description: A giant multi-headed bird hydra of Eldraine that lays a golden egg every hour; born from a witch's stew.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: Plane where the Goose Mother lives in the Wilds.

entities.name: Witch
entities.description: A witch who created the Goose Mother and was devoured by it.

entities.name: Fae folk
entities.description: Have a symbiotic relationship with the Goose Mother, trading meat for treasures.

entities.name: The Wilds
entities.description: Region of Eldraine where the Goose Mother lives.

entities.name: The Goose Mother and Other Tales
entities.description: An Eldraine folktale of which the Goose Mother is a subject.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion that came centuries after the Goose Mother's creation.

events.summary: A witch creates a stew of hydra's blood and goose feathers from which the Goose Mother is born; it grows to prodigious size.
events.quote: an enterprising witch created a frothy stew composed of hydra 's blood and goose feathers, from which the Goose Mother was born

events.summary: The witch hacks at the sleeping Goose Mother's neck with a cleaver, but two more heads sprout.
events.quote: two more heads sprouted in place of the first

events.summary: Enraged, the Goose Mother devours the witch and rampages into the Wilds, where it still lives.
events.quote: Enraged, the Goose Mother devoured the witch and rampaged deep into the Wilds
